activation_anchor.start: first 00:00:00 UTC strictly after a clean same-SHA deployment, an eligible full-history Canonical v2 replay, and shadow service restart
activation_anchor.test_end: start plus 90 calendar days; no early stopping
activation_anchor.lockbox_end: lockbox_start plus 30 calendar days; single use
activation_anchor.outcome_cutoff: entry and every label/path tick must be event-time inside its window and available no later than the evaluation cutoff

frozen_policy.change_rule: any change creates a new preregistration and a new untouched future window

costs.primary: measured entry/exit spread plus recorded slippage, commission, financing, and JPY conversion costs
costs.gap_and_same_tick_policy: persisted canonical replay semantics; same-millisecond ordering is source sequence then raw identity, and ambiguous stop/target is fail-closed stop-first

primary_endpoint.metric: mean realized canonical net R per closed trade
primary_endpoint.estimator: moving-block bootstrap over fixed five-calendar-day blocks, 10000 resamples, seed 20260811
primary_endpoint.pass_rule: two-sided 95% confidence interval lower bound is greater than 0.0R at 1x costs and mean expectancy remains greater than 0.0R at 2x costs

secondary_endpoints: maximum drawdown in R and JPY
pair, timeframe, session, and preregistered regime concentration
calibration diagnostics only when a fixed probability was emitted prospectively
baselines: direction-inverted counterfactual scored on identical canonical ticks and costs, diagnostic only
fixed random-sign baseline using seed 20260811 and identical observed entry opportunities, diagnostic only

multiple_testing.selection_trials: all policies, thresholds, fusion weights, models, and failed trials since registration must be present in the append-only trial ledger
multiple_testing.pbo: CPCV PBO over all admissible registered trials when at least eight nonoverlapping temporal blocks exist; otherwise unavailable
multiple_testing.dsr: deflated Sharpe ratio using the complete registered trial count; incomplete trial provenance makes the performance claim unavailable
multiple_testing.secondary_metrics: Holm adjustment; secondary endpoints cannot rescue a failed primary endpoint

decision_rule.test: report pass/fail/unavailable once after the fixed 90-day cutoff; never tune from it
decision_rule.lockbox: open once only after test reporting and governance approval
decision_rule.promotion_target: shadow remains the terminal deployment stage in this repository
decision_rule.fusion_or_ml_review: may begin only after the fixed test is reported; it must use a new future preregistration and cannot rewrite this result
